title: Does the job
text: Does the job. I gave this 4 stars because I had to put rubber bands around the base to keep the pad from curling. If the pad were made like a fitted sheet, that would be great, otherwise no complaints. I worked great.

product_metadata.title: LIGHT 'N' EASY Multi-Functional steam mop Steamer for Cleaning Hardwood Floor Cleaner for Tile Grout Laminate Ceramic, 7688ANW, White
features: On-demand HI, MED and LOW steam settings fit for various floors surface: marble, tile, grout, ceramic, stone, vinyl, laminate, and sealed wood flooring.
Detaches into a separate handheld steam cleaner for multi-purpose cleaning: garment wrinkle remover, upholstery refresher, bathroom/kitchen deep cleaning.
Smart Switch: Place it upright to cease steam, sparing your time to answer calls while protecting your hardfloor. Slant and glide to release powerful steam.
Utilizes 212°F hot steam to remove stains and sticky mess while drying quickly. Work with distilled or tap water, great for all homes with pets and babies.
Ideal for Child/Pets/Yoga Lovers: Only use tap water, no need of harsh chemicals.
Package Included: a steam mop, a microfiber pad, a fabric cleaning tool, a flexible hose, a jet nozzle and a filling cup.

details.Warranty Description: 1-year guarantee, plus a free replacement policy.
